title: A Windows checkout relying on system core.autocrlf reads as modified under isolated capture, and the refusal doesn't say why
outcome: A person or agent whose clean Windows checkout is refused because of line-ending config learns the cause and the supported next step from the refusal, without capture being weakened or any global configuration being changed.
acceptance: On a normal Windows clone under system core.autocrlf=true with no local override, the behaviour of isolated capture and of the launcher's clean report is shown by a recorded reproduction.

The refusal or report for that case names the line-ending cause and the supported next step, rather than only a list of modified files, and never claims a clean start that wasn't proved; capture's isolation from system and global config is unchanged.

docs/test.md states the requirement for a consumer checkout on Windows, and a deterministic test pins the behaviour. The exact candidate has a clean required review pair and passes the applicable gate, including on Windows.
